Memorization probe (`benchmark/probe.py`, `probe-desktop-opus-2026-11-02.json`): one no-tools desktop Opus subagent per paper, shown the title, authors, venue and each pinned claim's name, type and context, asked for each number from memory, scored with the blind-mode comparator.  *Within 2×* and *within 5×* count answers whose relative error is at most two or five times the claim's tolerance.  The last five columns are the blind-mode counts of the first two agent samples and the three pipeline samples, for comparison.  Over all 23 papers (the probe was not run on the R7 paper of ROADMAP 3.9, so this table stays 23-paper), of the 44 hits, 3 are derivable from the claim context, 4 pass a relative tolerance, and 37 land inside a ±1 SE band whose relative half-width is 6 % to 225 % (34 of 37 at or below 65 %).
